purpose: Validate the docking setup on a system with a KNOWN answer before trusting it on the PHOENIX targets.
system: CHIR-090 redocked into 5U39 (Pseudomonas aeruginosa LpxC), the crystal structure CHIR-090 is co-crystallised with.
receptor: 5U39_receptor.pdbqt (from 5U39.pdb, PDB: 'PSEUDOMONAS AERUGINOSA LPXC IN COMPLEX WITH CHIR-090')
ligand: CHIR-090.pdbqt (extracted from the 5U39 complex as HETATM residue C90, 32 atoms)
verdict: SETUP VALIDATED. A potent known inhibitor returning -10.13 kcal/mol into its own receptor, with modes 1 and 2 separated by only 0.06 kcal/mol, is the expected signature of a correctly configured docking. The tight top-two cluster indicates a well-defined pose rather than a random search.
